selectionBoundary: Each encoded encounter is one deterministic test choice from the authored StandardBehemoth pool. Chosen indexes and all positive-weight choices are retained; this does not model runtime random selection or spawn every MaxActivePrimaryContents actor. Map-only previews create no behemoth encounter.

localPreviewArtifacts.testCommand: From Phoenix Rising GameServer: $env:MPGS_BEHEMOTH_ENGINE="0"; python run.py --hunt <huntId> --template .atlas_cache/island_batch_preview/<huntId>.json
localPreviewArtifacts.runtimeLimit: Only the scripted encounter path is available without per-hunt engine manifests and terrain exports. Island U D24/heroic are map-only: arrival/map review works, no behemoth encounter is spawned.

interpretation.islandU: The zero-weight StandardBehemoth entry is not evidence of an empty island. Both U specs activate FirewatchHard and ToxicBehaviorHard PublicEvent assets at weighting 100; the heroic hunt points to the corresponding _heroic assets. Each asset contains a public_event_chooser_C, with public-event UI and loot rows, incoming/loot call-to-actions, and three ordered specific-behemoth-set chooser children. The chooser class inherits PhxGameContentSequenceChooser; ChooseContent_BP creates/registers a public_event_spec_C through IslandDirectorComponent, and public_event_spec_C inherits PhxGameContentSequenceSpecification. This source establishes a sequence-based public-event path in place of StandardBehemoth. The three chooser nodes line up with the three Stage.1-3 loot rows; assigning each node to a specific stage is inferred from order and still needs runtime verification. Candidate variants are level 30 on D24 and level 60 on heroic, all using ISLAND_U_CHALLENGE_TUNING. Inspected assets do not show a dedicated boss actor class or Pirate bounty flow; they show challenge-tuned public-event behemoth sequences.

islandUPublicEventFramework.consumerEvidence: public_event_chooser_C.ChooseContent_BP calls GameModeContentChooser.GetIslandDirectorComponent then IslandDirectorComponent.CreateAndRegisterSpecification(public_event_spec_C), casts and initializes it from UIDataRow, Content Pools and ContentLoot.
islandUPublicEventFramework.enumValuesSource: SDK Archon_structs.hpp EGameContentSequenceAdvanceCondition; chooser CDO does not serialize the selected default, so the active advance condition is unknown.
islandUPublicEventFramework.stageEvidence: 3 root-child specific_behemoth_set_chooser nodes per event; UI and loot data include Stage.1, Stage.2 and Stage.3. Mapping child order to those numbered phases is inferred.
islandUPublicEventFramework.liveStatus: The Phoenix server preview path does not yet instantiate or advance PublicEvent specifications. Island U previews remain map/arrival only.

implementationScope.atlas: Keep Island U public-event assets, chooser sequences, candidates, modifiers, tuning and loot/UI links mapped for reference.
implementationScope.phoenixIslandRuntime: Bypass PublicEvent implementation in the current island batch. U templates stay map/arrival-only and spawn neither a PublicEvent nor a substitute StandardBehemoth.
implementationScope.reason: The authored content is a PublicEvent sequence registered through IslandDirector and its stage lifecycle is not implemented in this preview path. Do not interpret the zero-weight StandardBehemoth pool as empty content or collapse the event into one regular encounter.

clientDisplayedHuntingGroundRegions.source: Local 2.1.1 English Game.locres supplies the seven client-visible region labels. Localized quest strings explicitly pair six regions with named island destinations; the Atlas player-hunt/map rows connect those island names to Adventure_Island hunt IDs and map packages.
clientDisplayedHuntingGroundRegions.interpretation: These are region -> island destination -> authored hunt/map links. A region label is not itself a hunt ID. This mapping establishes authored content identity, not that the current Phoenix client exposes every row as a selectable option or that matchmaking routes live.

candidateEvidence.rationale: This is the only D24 adventure hunt tagged as the Shattered Isles starter and assigned the tutorial exploration game mode; the localization and hunt tables do not explicitly state that the UI region tile routes to it.

regions.notes: Candidate connection only. Keep Ramsgate Outskirts distinct from the Ramsgate city return route; verify the actual client matchmaking row before treating the alias as authoritative.
